g.aria-label: box goal: GOAL — most useful private AI compute per dollar
g.text: GOAL — most useful private AI compute per dollar

g.aria-label: box own: QUESTION — already own capable compute?
box existing: YES — benchmark the existing GPU-PC first; zero acquisition cost is hard to beat
g.text: YES — benchmark the existing GPU-PC first; zero acquisition cost is hard to beat

g.aria-label: box bc: NO / WANT A SEPARATE APPLIANCE — price the complete BC-250 node
g.text: NO / WANT A SEPARATE APPLIANCE — price the complete BC-250 node

g.aria-label: box minimum: MINIMUM SPEND — board + reused PSU + reused SSD + two good fans + simple mount
g.text: MINIMUM SPEND — board + reused PSU + reused SSD + two good fans + simple mount

g.aria-label: box smart: SMART SPEND — ducting / thermal interface / telemetry / power quality before cosmetics
g.text: SMART SPEND — ducting / thermal interface / telemetry / power quality before cosmetics

g.aria-label: box avoid: DEFER — premium case / display / RGB / oversized storage / desktop peripherals
g.text: DEFER — premium case / display / RGB / oversized storage / desktop peripherals

g.aria-label: box bottle: QUESTION — what is the actual bottleneck?
g.text: QUESTION — what is the actual bottleneck?

g.aria-label: box simple: SIMPLICITY / LATENCY — conventional CUDA GPU may win
g.text: SIMPLICITY / LATENCY — conventional CUDA GPU may win

g.aria-label: box vram: CAPACITY — compare used 24-32 GB accelerators, accepting age / power / software trade-offs
g.text: CAPACITY — compare used 24-32 GB accelerators, accepting age / power / software

g.aria-label: box second: BOARD #2 CHECK — compare second BC-250 + 2.5 GbE adapters against one higher-memory alternative
g.text: BOARD #2 CHECK — compare second BC-250 + 2.5 GbE adapters against one higher-memory

g.aria-label: box fleet: CONCURRENCY — independent workers can scale jobs without forcing every model over the network
g.text: CONCURRENCY — independent workers can scale jobs without forcing every model over the

g.aria-label: box metric: MEASURE — total node cost / usable model quality / TTFT / tok-s / watts / thermals / maintenance
g.text: MEASURE — total node cost / usable model quality / TTFT / tok-s / watts / thermals /

g.aria-label: box rule: PURCHASE RULE — compare the whole node and workload, not the BC-250 board price alone
g.text: PURCHASE RULE — compare the whole node and workload, not the BC-250 board price alone
